name: com.streethawk.library.location.StreethawkBroadcastReceiver
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. Android starts this older receiver for boot, time-zone, Bluetooth, network, location-provider, and StreetHawk notification-response events. It restarts the SDK's location or beacon services and handles queued campaign actions.
disableEffect: StreetHawk tracking, beacon monitoring, and campaign actions will not resume after these events.
